name: Blast Fungus
description: Only the bravest of warriors carry the Blast Fungus. Not just because of its toxic spores, but because it smells awful.
properties: Shoots three blast fungus, which automatically detonate.

name: Boots of Swiftness
description: Boots blessed with enchantments to allow for swift movements. Useful in uncertain times such as these.

name: Buzzy Nest
description: Bee lovers and the bee-loved alike are fans of the Buzzy Nest, but don't be fooled by the cute bees within - they pack a powerful sting!

name: Corrupted Beacon
description: The Corrupted Beacon holds immense power within. It waits for the moment to unleash its wrath.
properties: Summons a beam that does incredibly heavy damage to enemies.

name: Corrupted Pumpkin
description: The Corrupted Pumpkin glows with supernatural power, illuminating even the darkest nights with its powerful beacon.

name: Corrupted Seeds
description: A pouch of poisonous corrupted seeds which grow into spiky grapple vines, entangling and slowly draining the life from its victims.

name: Death Cap Mushroom
description: Eaten by daring warriors before battle, the Death Cap Mushroom drives fighters into a frenzy.
properties: Greatly increase attack and movement speed.

name: Enchanted Grass
description: Just as there are powerful heroes who answer the call to fight, there are powerful enchanted sheep who will join the fight when summoned.

name: Enchanter's Tome
description: Meant only to be wielded by Enchanters, the magic of this artifact can summon powerful enchantments.
properties: Applies Double Damage, Fast Attack, or Quick to nearby allies.

name: Eye of the Guardian
description: The Eye of the Guardian holds a power that awakens in the hands of a worthy hero.
properties: Fires a continuous laser beam at mobs, similar to the Corrupted Beacon and Corrupted Pumpkin, but doesn't use souls and remains active for a limited time.

name: Fireworks Arrow
description: The explosive power of the TNT combined with the high velocity movement of an arrow - what could possibly go wrong?

name: Fishing Rod
description: The trusted companion of any true adventurer, the Fishing Rod is useful for more than just fishing.

name: Flaming Quiver
description: This quiver is filled with the deadliest of arrows.

name: Ghost Cloak
description: The souls trapped within the Ghost Cloak are protective, but they radiate a sense of melancholy.
properties: Gives player Ghost Form, increasing speed and defense for a short time.

name: Golem Kit
description: Iron Golems have always protected the Villagers of the Overworld. Their numbers are dwindling as a result of the Arch-Illager's war.

name: Gong of Weakening
description: This ancient gong, marked with the symbols of a nameless kingdom, feels safe in your hands but emits a menacing hum to those nearby.
properties: This gong reduces the amount of damage and health of the mobs around it.

name: Harpoon Quiver
description: This quiver holds a number of harpoons that swiftly pierce through enemies on land or underwater.

name: Harvester
description: The Harvester siphons the souls of the dead, before releasing them into a cluster hex of power.
properties: Creates a giant explosion near the player, consuming souls and dealing medium damage.

name: Ice Wand
description: The Ice Wand was trapped in a tomb of ice for ages, sealed away by those who feared its power.
properties: Creates an ice block on top of the nearest mob

name: Iron Hide Amulet
description: The Iron Hide Amulet is both ancient and timeless. Sand mysteriously and endlessly slips through the cracks in the iron.

name: Light Feather
description: No one knows what mysterious creature this feather came from, but it is as beautiful and powerful.
properties: Activates Rolling and triggers mobs to be pushed back and applies stunned.

name: Lightning Rod
description: Crafted by Illager Geomancers, this item is enchanted with the power of a storming sky.
properties: Summons a lightning bolt to attack the enemy at the cost of souls. Heavy damage.

name: Love Medallion
description: A spell radiates from this trinket, enchanting those nearby into a trance where they must protect the holder of the medallion at all costs.
properties: Turns up to three mobs near you into allies for ten seconds, then kills them. Mobs that have been charmed by this artifact also gain a damage boost when turning on other mobs. The damage of the mobs increased is directly proportional to the item's power level.

name: Powershaker
description: The Powershaker is a smashing good time, though it may not be as fun for your enemies.
properties: Applies an effect similar to Exploding.

name: Satchel of Elements
description: Mysteries surround this primordial satchel. Will it unleash fire, ice, or something a lot less nice?
properties: Applies Burning, Frozen, or strikes Lightning.

name: Satchel of Elixirs
description: The Satchel of Elixirs always contains the exact potions you need! (Well, at least the potions it thinks you need, which is still pretty helpful.)
properties: Crafts two random potions that can benefit the player.

name: Satchel of Snacks
description: The Satchel of Snacks provides a treat when you need it most!
properties: Crafts a random food item that can benefit the player.

name: Scatter Mines
description: Set your enemies up for the surprise of a lifetime with the explosive power of Scatter Mines.
properties: Summons three mines, which denotate upon contact. Similar to Redstone Golem's Mines. Allies no longer take damage from this artifact.

name: Shadow Shifter
description: The Shadow Shifter grants you Shadow Form, which allows you to stay out of sight.

name: Shock Powder
description: Shock Powder is a reliable tool for those who wish to make a swift exit.

name: Soul Healer
description: The Soul Healer amulet is cold to the touch and trembles with the power of souls.
properties: injured nearby, including the user, at the cost of souls.

name: Soul Lantern
description: This lantern, still covered in the sands of some far-flung place, allows those who hold it to summon a creature formed from bound souls.

name: Spinblade
description: This whirling weapon spins across the battlefield, slicing through enemies in its path.
properties: Slices through mobs, damaging them and eventually returning to the player.

name: Tasty Bone
description: You hear distant howling as you hold the Tasty Bone in your hand.

name: Thundering Quiver
description: This copper quiver channels the power of lightning.

name: Tome of Duplication
description: A magical tome which when read is capable of duplicating items such as food, potions and explosives!
properties: Creates a copy of the last consumable used by the player.

name: Torment Quiver
description: The Torment Quiver radiates powerful energy drawn from the eternal source of the Undead.

name: Totem of Casting
description: All who are near this totem feel an invigorating aura around their artifacts.
properties: Creates a boosting aura using souls to speed up other players' artifact cooldowns.

name: Totem of Regeneration
description: This hand-crafted wooden figurine radiates a warmth like that of a crackling campfire, healing those who gather around it.
properties: Creates a healing aura, which gradually heals players inside the aura.

name: Totem of Shielding
description: This totem radiates powerful energy that bursts forth as a protective shield around those near it.
properties: Protects player and allies in range from projectiles.

name: Updraft Tome
description: An ancient book filled with illegible glyphs, you feel a strange breeze as you flip through the pages.
properties: Sends seven mobs into the air, and then releases them, dealing fall damage.

name: Vexing Chant
description: Summons Guardian Vexes who will fight by your side for a short time.

name: Void Quiver
description: The Void Quiver is filled with arrows that splash Void Liquid when they hit their target.

name: Wind Horn
description: When the Wind Horn echoes throughout the forests of the Overworld the creatures of the night tremble with fear.
properties: Pushes enemies away and slows them briefly.

name: Wonderful Wheat
description: This item has the faint smell of an open field, baked bread, and freshly cut crops.
